part.text:
Fixed by backporting the upstream fix (redis/redis#13338) in `src/t_stream.c`:

1. **`streamRangeHasTombstones`** (src/t_stream.c:1400): removed the early `first_id > max_deleted_entry_id` return — a tombstone before the stream's first surviving entry can still sit *after* the group's `last-delivered-id`, which is what made lag report 2 instead of nil.
2. **`streamEstimateDistanceFromFirstEverEntry`** (src/t_stream.c:1497): added a check returning `SCG_INVALID_ENTRIES_READ` when the id is below `max_deleted_entry_id` (fragmentation between id and the stream's last-generated-id), so an invalid counter is no longer "recovered" incorrectly.
3. **`streamReplyWithRange`** (src/t_stream.c:1738): tombstone check now uses `group->last_id` instead of the newly delivered entry's id, so `entries_read` is only incremented when no tombstones exist between the group's last-delivered-id and the stream's last-generated-id — fixing `entries-read`/`lag` after reading to the end of the stream.

Both `unit/type/stream-cgroups` (including the previously failing lag test) and `unit/type/stream` pass.
